# Thailand

> [!summary] Data available
> Thailand has the most recipes in Southeast Asia (RecipeDB 2,600, Food.com 1,208, CulinaryDB 667) and the most KNApSAcK and CMAUP plant records, but no BLEnD culture and no processed FCT. Start with [[RecipeDB2]] / [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] (Q1), the Backlog Thai FCD (Q2), and [[KNApSAcK Family]] + [[CMAUP]] (Q3).

## Foods & dishes
- Recipes: [[RecipeDB2]] ≈2,600 "Thai" (v1; amounts, steps, not released); [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 1,208; [[CulinaryDB]] 667; [[IndicRecipeNutri]] 484 (Indian sites).
- Inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 58 dishes (17 Thailand-only); [[FmLAMA]] 32; [[World Wide Dishes]] 1.
- Not in [[BLEnD]]. All recipes are English-language, mostly Western adaptations.

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT processed. [[Thai Food Composition Database]] (v3 2025; candidate, priority 2); [[ASEAN Food Composition Database]] (priority 2).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
Thai traditional medicine has no dedicated source. [[KNApSAcK Family]] 2,554 records (705 edible / 1,849 medicinal); [[CMAUP]] 529 plants (third after China and India); [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 47 records; [[NPASS]] 348 pairs; [[Exposome-Explorer]] 33 rows; [[HERB]] 73 meta-analyses. Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No Thai-language recipes, no FCT processed, no BLEnD culture, no Thai traditional-medicine database.
